Wealthtrust Axiom Holds Stake in Team (TISI); Alibaba Group Hldg LTD (BABA) Shareholder Sloane Robinson Llp Has Trimmed Its Position by $3.35 Million
May 21, 2018 - By Migdalia James
Hugh Sloane decreased its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (BABA) by 22.94% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sloane Robinson Llp sold 19,500 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Hugh Sloane held 65,500 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $11.29M, down from 85,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sloane Robinson Llp who had been investing in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $501.05B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.52% or $1.02 $195. About 14.24 million shares traded. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 68.29% uptrending. It has outperformed by 56.74% the S&P500.
Wealthtrust Axiom Llc increased its stake in Team Inc (TISI) by 18.91% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wealthtrust Axiom Llc bought 35,219 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.88% with the market. The institutional investor held 221,437 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.30 million, up from 186,218 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wealthtrust Axiom Llc who had been investing in Team Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $625.24 million market cap company. The stock increased 0.72% or $0.15 $20.85. About 487,447 shares traded. Team, Inc. (NYSE:TISI) has declined 46.03% downtrending. It has underperformed by 57.58% the S&P500.

Analysts await Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) to report earnings on August, 16. They expect $1.16 earnings per share, up 23.40% or $0.22 from last year’s $0.94 per share. BABA’s profit will be $2.98 billion for 42.03 P/E if the $1.16 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.54 actual earnings per share reported by Alibaba Group Holding Limited for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 114.81% EPS growth.
